newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield at 6.535 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield at 6.535 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.535 percent at its auction of 91-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit on Thursday.
At its previous auction on September 12 for a similar amount, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.537 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.543/520 percent against 6.540/524 at last week's auction.
Dealers said the yield was lower due to more aggressive bidding by a banking system flushed with funds. Amount bidded for was 399 million ringgit against 339 million last week.
